# Feature: Refactor Project Toggle to Header Only

## Overview
Simplify the Kanban board by moving project management controls to the Navbar header component. The header will display a "Projects" navigation link and a project filter toggle (enable/disable projects), while all project CRUD operations (create, delete) move to the dedicated `/projects` page created in feature 2. This keeps the main board focused on task visualization and filtering, not management.

## User Stories
- **As an Admin user**, I want to toggle projects on or off from the header to quickly filter tasks by project without leaving the board view.
- **As an Admin user**, I want to access project management from the header and quickly navigate to it when needed.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- **Navbar (existing)** — Update to include:
  - Project filter toggle button/dropdown (show enabled projects)
  - "Projects" link to navigate to `/projects` management page
  - Keep theme toggle functionality
- **ProjectToggleDropdown component** — New lightweight dropdown
  - Located at `client/src/components/ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx`
  - Displays list of projects with checkboxes
  - Allows quick enable/disable of projects for filtering
  - Calls context to update enabled projects

### Data Model (Mock)
Use existing projects context/state. No new data structures needed.

### Simulated Backend
No backend changes. Uses existing project API for fetching list, and context state for toggle state.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Review current `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx`:
   - Identify ProjectManager component usage
   - Plan removal of inline project management controls
2. Create `client/src/components/ProjectToggleDropdown.jsx`:
   - Display list of all projects from context
   - Checkbox per project for enable/disable
   - Call context update method on toggle
   - Styled to match navbar theme
3. Update `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx`:
   - Remove inline ProjectManager component
   - Add ProjectToggleDropdown component
   - Add "Projects" navigation link that uses Wouter to route to `/projects`
   - Keep theme toggle
4. Update `client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`:
   - Remove any project management UI that exists there
   - Keep project filtering logic intact
5. Verify project filter still works on the board:
   - Toggle projects in dropdown
   - Board should update to show/filter tasks
6. Test:
   - Navbar displays projects toggle dropdown
   - Navbar has "Projects" link
   - Clicking "Projects" navigates to `/projects` route
   - Toggling projects in dropdown filters board correctly
   - No duplicate project management UI
